svg.title: Figure 6.5 Distribution of sample proportions
svg.desc: Histograms of the sample proportion with normal curves overlaid, for p = 0.1. (a) For n = 15 the histogram is skewed right and the interval p ± 3√(p(1 − p)/n), from −0.13 to 0.33, extends below 0. (b) For n = 100 the histogram is nearly bell-shaped and the interval, from 0.01 to 0.19, lies within [0, 1].
